name: Graduate Finance Association
mission: Prepares graduate students for careers in investment banking, private equity, and asset management through treks, stock pitches, and alumni panels.

name: Babson Investment Management Association
mission: Student-run portfolio managing real capital out of the Cutler Center. Weekly stock pitches and equity research training.

name: FinTech Club
mission: Explores the intersection of financial services and emerging technology, including AI-driven underwriting, payments infrastructure, and digital assets.

name: Babson AI Society
mission: Hands-on workshops on large language models, agent building, and applied machine learning for business students. Runs the semester AI Build Night.

name: Data Analytics Club
mission: Builds practical data fluency through Python and SQL bootcamps, Tableau labs, and applied machine learning case competitions.

name: Tech & Innovation Club
mission: Connects students to product management and technology careers. Hosts AI product teardowns and recruiting prep for tech firms.

name: Babson Consulting Club
mission: Case interview preparation, casing circles, and firm-specific recruiting support for consulting careers.

name: Entrepreneurship Club
mission: The founders' community at Babson. Pitch nights, co-founder matching, and office hours with Butler Launch Pad mentors.

name: Venture Capital & Private Equity Club
mission: Demystifies careers in VC and PE through deal breakdowns, term sheet workshops, and investor speaker series.

name: Babson Marketing Club
mission: Brand strategy workshops, agency site visits, and a spring consumer marketing case competition.

name: Real Estate Club
mission: Real estate finance and development careers, with property tours across Greater Boston and an annual REIT modeling workshop.

name: Healthcare Business Club
mission: Careers in biotech, pharma, and digital health, with a focus on the Boston/Cambridge life sciences corridor.

name: Energy & Environment Club
mission: Climate tech, ESG investing, and sustainable operations. Partners with Net Impact on the annual sustainability summit.

name: Net Impact
mission: Business as a force for social and environmental good. Runs impact consulting projects with local nonprofits.

name: Women in Business
mission: Leadership development, mentorship circles, and an annual conference supporting women across the Babson community.

name: Graduate Women in Finance
mission: Supports women pursuing finance careers through mentorship pairings, technical prep, and recruiting navigation.

name: Latin American Business Association
mission: Celebrates Latin American culture and builds professional bridges between Babson and Latin American markets.

name: Africa Business Club
mission: Showcases business opportunity across the African continent through the annual Africa Business Forum.

name: Asia Business Club
mission: Connects students to Asian markets and culture, including the Lunar New Year gala and APAC career panels.

name: Graduate Student Council
mission: The elected voice of graduate students. Allocates club funding and runs all-school social programming.

name: Babson Analytics & Operations Club
mission: Operations strategy, supply chain analytics, and process improvement with plant tours and simulation workshops.

name: Product Management Club
mission: Breaking into product management, including AI product strategy sessions and PM interview loops.

name: Retail & Luxury Goods Club
mission: Careers in retail, luxury, and consumer goods with NYC brand treks each fall.

name: Family Enterprise Club
mission: For students entering or leading family enterprises. Succession planning workshops and next-gen peer groups.

name: Babson Sports Business Club
mission: Sports business careers across leagues, agencies, and analytics, with Boston franchise front-office visits.

name: Graduate International Student Association
mission: Community and practical support for international graduate students, including OPT and visa navigation sessions.

name: Babson Robotics & Automation Club
mission: Hands-on robotics builds and automation applications for business, including computer vision and ML-driven control.

name: Real Talk Mental Health Collective
mission: Peer-led conversations and wellness programming that reduce stigma around mental health on campus.
